method: Reviewed the full draft against the Korea Consumer Agency wool duvet quality-comparison press release PDF (2025-03-13, KCA no=1003829397): spring/fall wool duvets measured 2.11-2.48 clo, stated as 50% of winter down duvet warmth, clo defined as a warmth unit that grows with the number, 0.37 clo best-to-worst gap equal to a thin short-sleeve gown at 0.35 clo, thermal testing per ASTM F1720-17, washing 3 times per labeled method with clumping in the 2 hand-wash-label products and no color/size/shape change in the 3 machine-wash-tested products, filling amounts 680g-2,240g (about 3.29x), duvet weights 1,930g-3,750g and thickness 1.2-2.5cm; and against the KCA 2017 down duvet test notice (KCA no=1001991652): only products with at least 75% down are labeled down products, goose labeling requires above 80% goose feathers-down, 3 products were nonconforming goose labels, one product's 80% down label was actually about 70%, prices ranged 299,000-980,000 KRW with rating not tracking price, and the care guidance of wool-cycle/duvet-cycle washing at about 30C, drying flat in a ventilated shade, fluffing after full drying, washing every 2-3 years and airing monthly for 1-2 hours. Static electricity figures come from the Ministry of the Interior and Safety SafetyNetTV clip (2023-12-22): winter humidity 10-20% and up to 35,000 V from walking on a carpet versus 220 V household power. Bedding hygiene guidance comes from the KDCA national health information portal chronic rhinitis Q&A: wash bedding at least weekly at 60 C or hotter. Wash-durability and label-recommendation test definitions come from the FITI Testing and Research Institute general quality testing page. All five source URLs were confirmed to return HTTP 200 on 2026-10-30. The affiliate ranking entries map live Coupang partner short links generated on 2026-10-30 for the top-ranked microfiber (Nolcha thick milk microfiber + wool microfiber duvet, 39,900 KRW), allergy-care (DiOFF antibacterial allergy-care lint-free duvet, 32,900 KRW) and goose down (Classic Fabric Hungarian 80% light goose duvet, 169,000 KRW) products, all verified to resolve with HTTP 200.
